messages:
maria: Heads-up: staging linkcheck failed after the locale import. Lots of anchor mismatches and a couple of asset 404s.
jon: I saw it too. The mdx pipeline is emitting raw unicode ids for headings in fr/zh which breaks existing slugified links.
kevin: images also got renamed during translation (e.g. "salle-de-reunion.png" -> URL-encoded path) so site refs don't match CDN keys.
lina: what's our rollback plan if hotfix doesn't land quickly?
maria: short term: implement ascii-fallback slugify and an assets manifest generator in the build. Longer: update CONTRIBUTING with filename guidelines.
jon: I can prototype a small plugin that forces ascii slug ids during markdown processing. will include tests for chinese and accented headers.
kevin: I'll replace the image rename step with a deterministic JS transliteration that emits a manifest mapping original -> ascii name.
ci-bot: linkcheck job started for branch fixes/slug-asset-hotfix (job 4890)
lina: once CI passes can someone spin up a staging preview and spot-check fr/zh pages?
jon: sure, I'll request a deploy preview in the PR description.
ci-bot: linkcheck finished: 0 anchor failures, 0 missing assets. deploy preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4890
maria: excellent. jon/kevin, please add a short note in docs explaining the ascii-fallback and how to run the local slug-check tool.
jon: done in PR description and added tools/slug-check.js.
maria: closing thread unless anyone sees regression. thanks!
_meta: generated: slack thread about ascii-fallback slugs and asset manifest to fix localized anchor/asset mismatches
